verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents automated evidence collection from 100+ or "hundreds" of integrations. Its framework pages describe automated control testing that collects compliance evidence from integrated technologies, backed by continuous daily monitoring with alerts. Custom integrations and an API extend this to tools without a native connector. missing for 10: explicit documentation that collected artifacts are timestamped and retained as audit evidence, a stated collection schedule beyond "daily monitoring", and independent or hands-on corroboration that manual screenshots and CSVs are actually eliminated.
